content_sections.heading: GNFC Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready while applying online: Updated Resume/ CV Educational Certificates Experience Certificates Age Proof Identity Proof Passport Size Photograph Signature Other supporting documents (if applicable) The notification specifically requires uploading a detailed resume with the online application.

content_sections.heading: GNFC Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply
content_sections.text: Visit the official GNFC recruitment portal through the application link mentioned in the notification. Register/Login. Fill in the online application form. Upload your detailed resume and required documents. Verify all entered details. Submit the application before 14 August 2026 .

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GNFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application along with the required resume is 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which job locations are available under GNFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates may be posted at Bharuch, Dahej, or Mumbai, depending on the post and organizational requirements.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for GNFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered under GNFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post. For example, Additional General Manager posts offer an approximate CTC of ₹30.77 lakh per annum, while other posts have different pay scales or contract-based remuneration.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for GNFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to fill out the online application form and upload their detailed resume through the official application link before the closing date.
